descriptionMarkdown:
This Base is made for BOB's mod version 2.1 or newer for Factorio 2.x (with or without SA) with 10 Books Full of Rails (2.23 or newer) as a Base

Needed MOD's:
- All Bob Mods ( 2.1 or newer )
- Wood Circuits Receipe ( https://mods.factorio.com/mod/woodcircuitrecipe )
- Mechanical Inserters ( https://mods.factorio.com/mod/exfret_mechanical_inserter )

10 Books of Rails Website:
https://github.com/Opinionated-Blueprints/10-Books-Full-of-Rails
